metric_definitions.micro_recall_at_3: Sum of qrel hits in the first 3 results divided by the sum of qrel counts across observed cases.
metric_definitions.macro_mrr: Mean per-case reciprocal rank across observed cases.
metric_definitions.macro_ndcg_at_3: Mean per-case binary nDCG@3 across observed cases.
metric_definitions.nonrelevant_retrieval_rate_at_3: Non-qrel retrieved results divided by all returned results in the first 3 positions across observed cases.

claim_boundary.observed: Archived Git-blob identity validation, existing BM25 execution, fixture-qrel IsREL application, and local retrieval metric counts.
claim_boundary.not_established: Independent or untuned evaluation, formal held-out performance, human review, claim support, answer usefulness, stable success rates, RAGAS scores, write authority, Graph routing, Apply, Build, or Runtime success.
claim_boundary.reserved_status: Reserved means excluded from development adjustment in this same-revision curated smoke fixture; it is not a formal held-out set.
claim_boundary.small_sample_reporting: Report counts and denominators before ratios.
